title: Among female patients aged 50 or older who have abnormal uric acid levels (
question: Among female patients aged 50 or older who have abnormal uric acid levels (UA > 6.5), also exhibit either low albumin (< 3.5) or high total protein (> 8.5), and have a recorded diagnosis, identify the diagnosis of the patient with the highest IgA level that falls strictly within the normal clinical range (80 < IGA < 500).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_064"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")) >= 50
  AND T2."XCL_022" > 6.5
  AND (T2."XCL_031" < 3.5 OR T2."XCL_020" > 8.5)
  AND T1."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."XCL_064" != ''
  AND T2."XCL_043" > 80
  AND T2."XCL_043" < 500
ORDER BY T2."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 1;
